title: Sucralose: FDA Status, Emerging Safety Concerns & Regulatory Intelligence
excerpt: Comprehensive regulatory intelligence on sucralose (Splenda/E955), covering FDA approval under 21 CFR 172.831, the 2026 EFSA re-evaluation, sucralose-6-acetate genotoxicity findings, MAHA Commission scrutiny, and state-level school food restrictions.
seo_title: Sucralose: FDA Status, EFSA Review & Regulatory Risk Assessment | Policy Canary
seo_description: Regulatory intelligence on sucralose (Splenda). FDA-approved under 21 CFR 172.831 with ADI of 5 mg/kg/day. EFSA 2026 re-evaluation confirms safety but flags high-heat concerns. MAHA Commission lists sucralose as 'of potential concern.'

key_deadlines.label: EFSA 2026 re-evaluation published — confirmed ADI of 15 mg/kg/day, declined extension to fine bakery wares
Texas SB 25 school meal restrictions take effect
Louisiana SB 14 school meal ban effective (2028-2029 school year)
MAHA Commission strategy released — lists sucralose as 'of potential concern'
Sucralose-6-acetate genotoxicity study published (Schiffman et al.)
WHO conditional recommendation against non-sugar sweeteners for weight control
